semiconductor_relevance: High — Longsun specializes in R&D and production equipment for semiconductor manufacturing and thin film solar cells.
summary: Beijing Longsun Technology Co., Ltd. is an equipment supplier focused on the semiconductor industry, providing advanced systems for deposition, etching, and solar cell production. Their product offerings include magnetron sputtering systems, PECVD systems, and various specialized gas valves, catering to both research and production needs.

regional_presence.Germany: Longsun collaborates with German companies for advanced equipment solutions.
